content:
Here's an idiomatic implementation following the knr-ops patterns (Flux + kustomize base/overlays + ACK + SOPS).

## Directory layout

```
infra/
  s3-logs/
    base/
      kustomization.yaml
      bucket.yaml
      versioning.yaml
      encryption.yaml
      public-access-block.yaml
    overlays/
      dev/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
      prod/
        kustomization.yaml
        patch-bucket.yaml
  iam/
    s3-logs-irsa/
      base/
        kustomization.yaml
        role.yaml
        policy.yaml
      overlays/
        dev/kustomization.yaml
        prod/kustomization.yaml
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml   (add logs kustomization)
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/`

**`bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1      # overridden per overlay
  # bucket name set via overlay patch (myapp-logs-{env})
```

**`versioning.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

**`encryption.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: true
```

**`public-access-block.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/`

**`patch-bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucket: myapp-logs-dev
```

**`kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: crossplane-system   # match your ACK/provider namespace
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
# propagate region to sub-resources
patchesStrategicMerge: []
```

> To keep region consistent across sub-resources in dev/prod, add region patches too:

```yaml
patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml
    target:
      kind: Bucket
  - target:
      kind: BucketVersioning
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
  - target:
      kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
  - target:
      kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
```

## `infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod/`

**`patch-bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucket: myapp-logs-prod
```

**`kustomization.yaml`** — same as dev but with `patch-bucket.yaml` pointing at prod (and region patches; use us-west-2 replication region if you mirror the app-assets pattern).

---

## `infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/base/`

**`role.yaml`** — IRSA role with OIDC trust
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    # assumeRolePolicy set per overlay (OIDC provider differs per cluster)
    forceDetachPolicies: true
```

**`policy.yaml`** — least-privilege read/write scoped to the logs bucket
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    # policy document set per overlay (bucket ARN differs)
```

**`kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
  # RolePolicyAttachment tying them together:
  - attachment.yaml
```

**`attachment.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-rw
```

## `infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: crossplane-system
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/assumeRolePolicy
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID" },
              "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
              "Condition": {
                "StringEquals": {
                  "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                  "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                }
              }
            }]
          }
  - target:
      kind: Policy
      name: myapp-logs-rw
    patch: |
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/policy
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Sid": "ListBucket",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": ["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],
                "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
              },
              {
                "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],
                "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
              }
            ]
          }
```

The **prod overlay** is identical in shape but:
- prod OIDC provider ARN / cluster id
- `arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod` and `/*`
- **no wildcard actions** (already explicit — satisfies least-privilege for prod)

> Account IDs / OIDC ids are not secret; if you prefer to keep them out of Git, store them in a **SOPS-encrypted** `secret.enc.yaml` and reference via a `ConfigMap`/env substitution. Any actual secret (e.g. DB connection strings elsewhere) stays SOPS-encrypted — this logs bucket introduces no plaintext secrets.

---

## `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (add these entries)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system        # match your existing source
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: iam-s3-logs-dev    # role must exist first
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: iam-s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  path: ./infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: iam-s3-logs-prod
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: iam-s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
  path: ./infra/iam/s3-logs-irsa/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

---

## How this satisfies the acceptance criteria

| Requirement | Where |
|---|---|
| Versioning enabled | `versioning.yaml` (`status: Enabled`) |
| SSE AES256 | `encryption.yaml` (`sseAlgorithm: AES256`) |
| No public access | `public-access-block.yaml` (all 4 blocks true) |
| Bucket name `myapp-logs-{env}` | overlay `patch-bucket.yaml` |
| IRSA role read/write | `iam/s3-logs-irsa` role + scoped policy + attachment |
| Least privilege (no wildcard in prod) | explicit S3 actions, ARN-scoped to the logs bucket |
| Env isolation | separate overlays + separate Flux kustomizations (`-dev` / `-prod`) |
| SOPS | Flux `decryption.provider: sops`; sensitive IDs can be SOPS-encrypted |
| Separate reconciliation | dedicated `s3-logs-dev/prod` Flux Kustomizations with `dependsOn` on the IAM role |

A couple of things to align with **your** repo before committing:
1. Confirm the ACK/provider **namespace** (I used `crossplane-system` — swap for your ACK controller namespace).
2. Confirm the **GitRepository/OCIRepository source name** used in existing `flux/kustomizations.yaml`.
3. Fill in real **OIDC provider ARNs** and **account IDs** for each cluster.

If your existing `infra/s3/` uses ACK's `s3.services.k8s.aws` API instead of `s3.aws.upbound.io`, mirror that group/kind exactly — match whatever the existing app-assets bucket uses so the new bucket is truly idiomatic.
